A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. All 14 pages of each version are readable, including corresponding equations, Tables 1–13, Figures 1–6, and Appendix A, supporting a complete comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original quantized-model accuracy evaluations, text-similarity analyses, and hardware inference measurements in Sections 4–5, with additional results in Appendix A.

after.justification: v4 retains those original empirical results, including the reasoning evaluations, inference benchmarks, and appendix per-run scores.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 retains the same FP8 round-to-nearest, INT8 GPTQ/SmoothQuant, and INT4 GPTQ quantization procedures. No algorithmic component or model procedure changes.

E1.justification: The Open LLM leaderboards, Arena-Hard, HumanEval/HumanEval+, MBPP, RULER, reasoning benchmarks, text-similarity evaluation, and seven deployment scenarios are retained without coverage changes.

E2.justification: The BF16 baselines and quantization comparator sets are unchanged. GPTQ-versus-AWQ comparisons retain identical membership in Tables 1, 8, 12, and 13.

E3.justification: Both retain the same model configurations, leaderboard prompts, evaluation metrics, reasoning generation settings, and synchronous/asynchronous GPU workload protocols. No experimental setting is revised.

E4.justification: The text-similarity investigation and latency–throughput analyses in Figures 1–3 remain unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both retain two Arena-Hard runs with 95% confidence intervals in Table 7, 20 reasoning responses per query in Section 4.3, and the same uncertainty-reporting practice in Table 4.

E6.justification: Matched numerical entries and plotted findings in Tables 1–13 and Figures 1–6 are unchanged, including appendix per-run scores and accuracy recoveries. No result is added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The round-to-nearest quantization definition and zero-point/scale expressions in Section 2.1, Equation (1), are mathematically identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about near-lossless FP8, modest INT8 degradation, competitive INT4 accuracy, GPTQ versus AWQ, and deployment-dependent efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of activation-quantization difficulty and deployment trade-offs are unchanged. The same limitations concerning other model-component compression and multilingual or specialized applications remain.

D1.justification: Calibration and group-size details, vLLM 0.6.4.post1, hardware configurations, and Appendix A.3/Table 9 pricing assumptions are unchanged. No reproducibility resource or access instruction is added or removed.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning against prior quantization studies are identical. References shift position, but no cited research or novelty argument is added or removed.

P1.justification: v4 adds an Acknowledgements section between Limitations and References identifying Austrian Science Fund support, 10.55776/COE12, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and narrative organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgement reflows the references onto page 13 and shifts existing Appendix A content, including Figures 5–6 and Table 9. Figure/table content, captions, and structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 adds funding attribution, while retaining the same methods, evidence, uncertainty reporting, claims, and limitations throughout the main text and appendices. The accompanying reference and appendix reflow causes no material readability change, so overall paper quality is meaningfully unchanged.
